description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0075 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Token risk comparison: two ERC-20 tokens side by side: which has the lower risk score and why, flags only one of them has, taxes, holders, liquidity, volume, plus a short AI verdict from the computed facts (rule-based fallback). Base or Ethereum. Data: GoPlus Security public API (contract flags, taxes, honeypot simulation, holders, LP lock) + DexScreener (pairs, liquidity, volume). Every flag names its source field. Not financial advice. When to use: Use token-compare when an agent must choose between two tokens.
